folder: Driver App > Ride Flows > Forward Dispatch Rides
steps: Scenario: Driver on an active trip sees the next-leg ETA on a Forward Dispatch offer instead of the cumulative ETA Given a driver is on an active trip with a passenger And the driver receives a Forward Dispatch offer for a new ride When the offer card is displayed to the driver Then the displayed ETA should reflect only the travel time from the driver's drop-off location to the next pickup location And the displayed ETA should not include the remaining time of the driver's current trip And the matched passenger on the new ride should see the full cumulative wait time, including the driver's remaining current-trip time And the backend logs and reports should record the absolute cumulative ETA for that ride

title: Voucher Replacement from darb0 to darb100 on Price Check Screen – Backend Promotion Validation
folder: Backend Services > Matching & Dispatching > RCRC DARB Integration > Deep Link Functionality
preconditions: Description: User lands on the app via a deep link that contains a 0% discount voucher ( darb0 ). On the price check screen, the user removes the darb0 voucher and applies another voucher ( darb100 ). The system should validate voucher replacement rules from the backend. Ideally, the backend promotion validation should not allow voucher override if the deep link voucher is fixed/locked, or should properly revalidate eligibility before applying the new voucher. Preconditions: Deep link contains voucher code darb0 (0% discount). Promotion darb0 is valid and auto-applied through deep link. Another promotion darb100 exists and
steps: Launch the app using a deep link containing voucher code darb0 . Verify that user lands on the Price Check screen. Confirm that voucher darb0 is auto-applied. Remove the darb0 voucher manually. Enter and apply voucher code darb100 . Observe network calls (promotion validation API). Check backend response and UI behavior.
expected: Backend promotion validation API should: Either reject replacing the deep link voucher (if business rule restricts override). Or properly revalidate eligibility and allow only if conditions are met. App should not allow invalid voucher override. Correct error message should be displayed if replacement is not allowed. No inconsistent discount calculation should occur. Final fare should reflect only valid, backend-approved promotion.
